fedifeeds-summary-category:
Summary of the ActivityPub account that follows a category.

Parameters:
* $1 - the category's title, with namespace
fedifeeds-summary-section:
Summary of the ActivityPub account that follows the new sections of a page.

Parameters:
* $1 - the page's title, with namespace
fedifeeds-rest-no-feed:
Error from the REST API when a handle or WebFinger resource names no feed.

Parameters:
* $1 - the handle or resource asked for
fedifeeds-rest-no-note:
Error from the REST API when a note path names no item of a feed that publishes notes.

Parameters:
* $1 - the path asked for, such as category_4521/notes/88
fedifeeds-rest-no-quote-authorization:
Error from the REST API when a path names no quote authorization of a feed, for example because the quote was withdrawn.

Parameters:
* $1 - the path asked for, such as category_4521/quote_authorizations/3
fedifeeds-info-times:
Value of {{msg-mw|fedifeeds-info-announces}} and {{msg-mw|fedifeeds-info-likes}} on action=info.

Parameters:
* $1 - the number, formatted
fedifeeds-info-others:
Follows the accounts named after a total on action=info.

Parameters:
* $1 - how many other accounts gave the reaction, which are not named
fedifeeds-info-people:
Shown after a total on action=info when no account can be named.

Parameters:
* $1 - how many accounts gave the reaction
fedifeeds-info-all: Link text, in parentheses after a total on action=info, to [[Special:FediFeedsReactions]] for the page.
fedifeeds-reactions-page:
{{Identical|Page}}
Label of the page title field on [[Special:FediFeedsReactions]].
fedifeeds-reactions-title:
Page title of [[Special:FediFeedsReactions]] for a page.

Parameters:
* $1 - the page's title
fedifeeds-reactions-totals:
Totals above the list on [[Special:FediFeedsReactions]].

Parameters:
* $1 - how many Announces
* $2 - how many Likes
fedifeeds-reactions-off: Shown on [[Special:FediFeedsReactions]] instead of the form while $wgFediFeedsInteractions is false.
fedifeeds-reactions-none: Shown on [[Special:FediFeedsReactions]] when the page's notes have no reactions.
fedifeeds-reactions-no-page:
Error on [[Special:FediFeedsReactions]].

Parameters:
* $1 - the title asked for
fedifeeds-reactions-hidden: Stands for an account in a row of [[Special:FediFeedsReactions]] when the account does not let itself be discovered.
fedifeeds-reactions-category:
Heading of the group of a category feed's note on [[Special:FediFeedsReactions]].

Parameters:
* $1 - the category's name, without namespace
fedifeeds-reactions-section-nth:
{{optional}}
Heading of the group of a section note whose heading path occurs more than once.

Parameters:
* $1 - the heading path
* $2 - which occurrence
fedifeeds-reactions-section-unknown: Heading of the group of a section note whose heading path was too long to keep.
fedifeeds-reactions-path-separator:
{{optional}}
Between the headings of a heading path on [[Special:FediFeedsReactions]].
fedifeeds-reactions-type: Column heading on [[Special:FediFeedsReactions]]: whether the row is an Announce or a Like.
